censoring_note: visits whose berth was not seen by 2024-12-31 are dropped; waits > 45 d dropped; joins near the window end are biased toward short waits

net_understatement.note: sum over joining ships of (actual wait - reported wait the day before); positive = the published figure was too short on net. Headline this one, not the per-ship sums.

gap_cost.note: 940 visits joining in the window. 'longer than told' = sum over ships of max(0, actual wait - the figure available the day before it joined): idle time nobody planned for, which slow steaming could have moved to sea. Priced at 4.7 t fuel and 130 kg NOx per ship-day at anchor (shared/emissions.json) and $780/t MGO; ships loitering offshore are priced the same (an approximation).
